Avnet Convenes Partners for Edge AI Growth in Singapore

Technology firm Avnet has gathered its ecosystem partners in Singapore to foster the expansion of Edge Artificial Intelligence (AI). The initiative aims to accelerate the adoption and development of Edge AI solutions within the region. This collaboration seeks to leverage collective expertise to drive innovation and market growth in the burgeoning field of AI.
